title: The Genealogy and Rise of Gulab Rai

blocks.text: The page pauses to explain lineage, insisting that Sri Guru Hargobind Singh fathered five respectable sons and tracing the branch through Suraj Mal so Gulab Rai can be placed within the wider family story.
From that line the narrative names Gulab Rai, then Shyam Chand, and finally Dalel Singh and Jodh Singh, presenting the household as one that inherited visibility without preserving discipline.
Its main point is moral rather than genealogical: wealth and affluence made the family proud, and within a span of two years, he met his doomed end, showing how quickly worldly prestige collapsed.
